/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.request import urlopen

class Page(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title = ''
        self.in_title = False
        self.description = None
        self.links = []
        self.lang = None
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        values = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'html': self.lang = values.get('lang')
        if tag == 'title': self.in_title = True
        if tag == 'meta' and values.get('name') == 'description': self.description = values.get('content')
        if tag == 'a': self.links.append((values.get('href'), values.get('data-nextjs-router'))) 
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == 'title': self.in_title = False
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.in_title: self.title += data

for path, title, description, links in [
    ('/', 'Home Page', 'Welcome to our Next.js app', ['/about', '/contact']),
    ('/about', 'About Us', 'Learn more about us', ['/', '/contact']),
]:
    with urlopen('http://localhost:3100' + path) as response:
        assert response.status == 200, (path, response.status)
        html = response.read().decode()
    page = Page()
    page.feed(html)
    assert page.lang == 'en', (path, page.lang)
    assert page.title == title, (path, page.title)
    assert page.description == description, (path, page.description)
    assert [href for href, _ in page.links] == links, (path, page.links)
    print(f'{path}: 200, title={page.title"'!r}, description={page.description!r}, links={links}'"')
PY"
